content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe offers a robust payment processing service, but it's limited to only 46 countries, excluding many key markets. PayPal provides a widely recognized platform, yet it can suspend accounts without appeal, leaving funds locked for up to 180 days. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also fail to support a broad range of countries, making them non-starters for many creators. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH enables creators to establish their online stores using tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, ensuring a reliable and sovereign payment processing experience without the typical limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are not designed to serve creators in restricted countries, leaving them out of the digital economy entirely. Stripe's limited global reach means that many creators are excluded simply due to their geographical location. PayPal's stringent policies can lead to account freezes, which create uncertainty for users. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure does not restrict access based on location. It allows creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and similar regions to leverage tools and cryptocurrencies for seamless transactions, ensuring they maintain full control over their sales processes.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal both charge transaction fees, and their systems can introduce delays in payment processing, especially for users in unsupported countries. PayPal's ability to suspend accounts adds another layer of risk. In comparison, using NOWPayments as part of a sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies at a much lower fee of just 0.5%. Transactions can be confirmed on-chain almost instantly, meaning creators can access their funds without unnecessary wait times or fees, making this a more efficient solution for digital product sales.
Sovereignty in commerce means no more reliance on restricted platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor when assessing payment platforms. With Stripe and PayPal, creators are subject to the whims of these platforms and their policies. Account restrictions can jeopardize access to funds and data. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to own everything after deployment. Solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack ensure that creators can automate their order processes and deliver digital products instantly through reliable storage solutions without dependence on third-party platforms. This architecture provides true sovereignty, enabling creators to focus on their craft rather than navigating complex payment hurdles.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you're looking for a quick setup with limited products, the Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal. However, if you're ready for a more comprehensive solution, the Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go. It supports multiple products, offers a full configuration for SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and ensures everything is end-to-end tested before handoff. This stack not only provides immediate functionality but also positions you for growth without the constraints of traditional platforms. The foundation you choose will determine your long-term success in the digital marketplace.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure. This model allows you to build your online store using tools that do not impose geographical restrictions. Solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack offer a complete package for selling digital products without relying on platforms like Stripe.
Instant payment confirmations empower creators with real-time access to funds.

If you’re searching for ways to sell digital products without relying on platforms like Gumroad, check out the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) on our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It offers a full suite of deployment tools specifically designed for creators in restricted regions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

Using solutions like Cloudflare R2 for file delivery and NOWPayments for payment confirmations, you can automate the delivery of digital products efficiently, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly.
